assets.prompt: The Bone Husk, a horde swarmer: a hollow thighbone club, broad twin-knobbed head with a dark hollow across it where its two eyes glow, a thick cracked Bone shaft bound with a Wood band, a heavy knobbed foot and a Spark ferrule. Wider and heavier than the other strays (16 px wide), a slow brute. A 32x32 body with its ferrule at the bottom (row 28), 1px dark outline, light from the top-left; the face (eyes and brows) is a separate layer. Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no player colours.
